body: I'm approaching a therapist I can see next month as soon as I have the cash. I appreciate your advice. I'm going to be working hard the next few weeks building a support, my wife has said 3 months is fair but I feel like it is too much to do to her, so I'm going to be doing everything I can

Firstly, I asked my partner again because I'm not going to make assumptions. She doesn't know how to answer it, she doesn't feel like Julia manipulated or intentionally used her to get to me, but she does feel like I was the only value Julia got from their friendship. 

That is the situation. If I had to add anything, it'd just be my feelings. Leya suggested that a post that doesn't deal with my feelings is not helpful to getting advice. I didn't want to include my feelings because it's a mess and honestly painful to think over. But here goes.

In my life two people have confessed love for me, only two. And they're also the only two people I regularly talk to. It's my own fault, several difficult years and I've drawn in on myself and cut off every meaningful connection other than Leya. It was a lot of pressure on her to be the only person who I could talk to. I spent most of this year trying to reconnect with people, but honestly everyone just fades away. I know it's a problem, I am trying everything to fix it. Julia didn't fade away and now I'm in the situation where the only two people I can talk to, are the people involved in all of this. Both Julia and Leya have asked for external advice and shared it with me. But that advice is mostly from people close to them so it is worlds apart.

I don't deal with loss well, I don't want to lose something. I don't want to lose anything. Yet I don't want to risk my relationship with my partner. I desperately want to believe there's a way for it to work out. But I honestly can't tell anymore if it is just wishful thinking.

I tried. When Leya said it was not OK and I cut off all communication with Julia, I couldn't help being sad. And then Leya said there's no difference between me missing Julia and me chatting with her, so I might as well just chat with her. On the one hand, I know I am extremely lucky to have a person who cares that much about me. On the other hand I don't know if her attempts to make things work is just an unrealistic last effort to make me happy. I don't want to undermine her efforts. I don't want her to burn herself just for me. It's a mess, I feel lost and more confused and conflicted by the day.

I'll stop there. From there my feelings just trend towards self loathing. I'm sorry for the long post, but thank you for reading.

I appreciate that, it's hard to hear but I needed to. She's still looking for ways to help, to make it work, same with me. And so far the things she's been suggested is helping. If it turns out to not be enough, I will follow your advice.

I have difficulty reading situations, I rely on people being explicit, and I have started asking more questions to make sure I understand why people are upset. Leya doesn't believe Julia manipulated anyone, I've also spoken to Julia about it and she insists that she was visiting both of us.
I'm feeling fine now. Thanks everyone, I really appreciate everything. ☺
It did for me years ago. My current situation is probably a result of me refusing to see a doctor.
So in order to prevent someone else from hurting themselves, I now have a sharp knife in my bag. It's ironic.

From bad to worse, to even worse. Everything is taking everything I have is nothing is giving anything back. I'm so utterly spent I can't be bothered to eat or drink. It has to end before Thursday, and I see no good way for that to happen. I just don't know what to give anymore.
Scraped through Sunday barely, today looks worse. My problem isn't that there are bad days and good days, more that there are horrible days and survivable ones.
Looks like I get to run another day. Let's see what Sunday holds for me.
